items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: so that was my first teacher was Charlie Brooks.

ctx.x: That's a nice walk for a drummer with all of his equipment.

Oh yes, yes. But when I was taking lessons, see, I didn't have to bring my drums. He had the practice pad and things up there, you know, so that was my first teacher was Charlie Brooks. Then I hated to go up there for lessons for the simple reason his wife could play drums and also his son, and my time to take a lesson, they would always be home and sitting right in the same room where I would be taking my lessons. Well if I'd do something wrong, well he would reprimand me and there they'd be sitting there, you…
How old were you when this was taking place?
